name: travel-cost-site
description: 旅游费用查询网站：Vue3 前端 + Express 4 后端 + MySQL（一条命令装依赖、打包、启动）

scripts.build: npm --prefix web ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix web ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix server ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
